headline: Billing processing controls
narrative: Billing jobs retry temporary failures within a limit, while transactional event-ID handling prevents repeated intake from enqueueing the same ID again.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: Permanent errors are not retried by this path. Exactly-once external charging and production success rates are not established.

headline: Billing diagnostics and tests
narrative: Failed jobs produce a counter and job-ID log. Tests exercise retry limits and repeated-event intake.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: Alert thresholds, automated operational response, and measured production outcomes are outside these changes.
